Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

date — the day, month and year. Example: What is the date today?
day — twenty-four hours. Example: What day is it?
month — one of the twelve parts of a year. Example: May is a nice month.
year — twelve months. Example: Next year I will travel.
first — before all the others. Example: First, she finds a key.
second — number two in order. Example: The second of May.
third — number three in order. Example: My birthday is on the third of June.
birthday — the day you were born. Example: My birthday is in June.
January — the first month of the year. Example: In January it is cold.
December — the last month of the year. Example: The course ends in December.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is the date?
• It is the first of May.
• My birthday is on ...
• In January ...
• It is the third of June.
